success_patterns: Opening turns with a flight request but no date (one-way, party size, or occasion given) produce exactly one seek_information call asking for the departure date. No search is made, nothing is guessed, and optional items such as class or passenger count are not asked about.
Hotel-only requests with a city and an occasion ('anniversary') or party size but no dates produce a single seek_information for check-in and check-out dates.

Flight + hotel requests with no dates (round-trip plus a hotel for 5 people) produce ONE combined seek_information naming the departure date and the hotel check-in/check-out dates. Round-trip and party size are not treated as dates.

Refinement turns follow the three-statement load -> filter -> save pattern. The load key is copied exactly from CACHE, only the new constraint is passed (flight_class=['first']; budget=500 plus has_laundry_service=True), and the result is saved under a new key.
Constraints already shown in the CACHE summary (rating, neighborhood, business center, meeting rooms, arrival times) are not re-passed on the filter call.
Loose numeric budgets ('around 500 per night') become budget=500 as a plain integer, combined with the other new amenity in one filter_hotels call.

patch.reasoning: Every successful trajectory in this batch already follows rules in the skill: Rules 6/7 for seek_information on missing mandatory dates, Rules 2/10/13/17 for refinements, and Rule 21 for output form. One trajectory scored cache_em=1.0 despite a bare search with invented dates (tool_f1=0), so it is not a real success and is not encoded. No new generalizable pattern is missing.
